name: claude-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: easier-to-skim replies and a workshop pane.

plugins.name: skim-colors
plugins.description: Makes Claude's long replies easy to skim: the points that matter are bright and bold, the rest is quieter, and risks and decisions sit in quiet boxes.

plugins.name: workshop
plugins.description: One side pane listing everything you can use in Claude Code (slash commands, skills, mods, hooks) with what you use most at the top, plus your ideas. Open it with /ws.
